title: NEW MPT-7B-StoryWriter CRUSHES GPT-4! INSANE 65K Tokens Limit!
author: fisj

comments.author: fisj
comments.body: The pace of open source LLM development is staggering.

comments.author: somethingclassy
comments.body: This isn't available yet for use though, right?

replies.author: fisj
replies.body: It appears like it is. He demonstrates some of the 4 new models, including the 65k token version. Its not 4bit quantized tho and the 65k tokens eat up lots of vram, so basically you need server level hardware to run it. His 4090 crapped out using it. I expect someone will quantize it, and it might run decently on a 4090, but thats still out of reach for most people. Still, very exciting and the other models seem good too.
